# Scenario: working prod domain stays live when settings switch to a new domain
# whose ACME fails (non-429) → .retries block + nginx conf rolled back.
#
# Mirrors: dig returns some IP (registrar parking) with no certs.publicIP, so
# DNS preflight passes; ACME challenge/CA then fails → block, not skip.
# Cycle 1 issues prod for domain A (Pebble); cycle 2 points ACME at a dead
# directory and changes domain-name to B.

pebble-start

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: prod domain A baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.pebble .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# --- Cycle 1: domain A + prod via Pebble ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-keep\.apinfra\.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-keep.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'server_name e2e-keep\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'listen 443 ssl' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Live proxy healthcheck for domain A.
exec curl -skf --resolve e2e-keep.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-keep.apinfra.test/

pebble-stop

# Dig now returns a non-local "parking" IP; no certs.publicIP → preflight still OK.
cp bin/dig.parking bin/dig
chmod 0755 bin/dig

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.domain-b.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: switch to domain B without working ACME'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.fail .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# --- Cycle 2: domain B ACME fails → block B, restore conf for A ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issuance failed'
stderr 'cert issue blocked domain=e2e-bad\.apinfra\.test'
stderr 'rolled back those service confs'
stderr 'done duration='

grep 'blocked: true' $HOME/.retries
grep 'e2e-bad\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/.retries
grep 'cert_issue_failed' $HOME/.events
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-bad.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem

# Previous prod conf / cert for A must still be what nginx serves.
grep 'server_name e2e-keep\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'server_name e2e-bad\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'e2e-keep\.apinfra\.test=.*\|prod' $HOME/.installedCert
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-keep.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

exec curl -skf --resolve e2e-keep.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-keep.apinfra.test/

-- .apinfra.pebble --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=zerossl
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- .apinfra.fail --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.triesCount=1
certs.blockHours=24
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certIssueTimeout=10s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-keep.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- settings.domain-b.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-bad.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- bin/dig.parking --
#!/bin/sh
# Non-empty answer that is not the e2e host (registrar parking stand-in).
echo '203.0.113.10'

-- .env --
